variants.prompt:
Edit the attached existing EVO BASE FISH into ONE complete, beautifully finished 2D game character asset for its BITE/JAW evolution line. Exact style continuity with the reference is essential: same slate-blue silver stout prehistoric fish, softly hand-painted masses, confident dark navy organic ink outline, ivory-grey translucent fin membranes, silver-white belly, large round cream-and-black eye with the same highlight, simple integrated gill fold. Keep the tail, body, all fins, dorsal profile, eye size and eye location almost identical to the reference. Only redesign the mouth, teeth, lips and supporting lower cheek/mandible. The skull and forehead remain the SMOOTH UNARMOURED BASE FORM: absolutely NO skull helmet, forehead bone plates, head armour, horns or body armour. This is a separate upgrade branch from skull evolution.

Strict orthographic side view facing RIGHT, perfectly horizontal neutral swimming pose, not attacking or lunging. Show the evolved dentition in a calm near-closed resting mouth, with interlocking tooth tips naturally visible along a slim dark mouth slit. All stages must be distinguishable through the actual jaw silhouette and tooth design, NOT merely by opening the mouth wider or changing its expression. Keep the eye alert and characterful, not angry. Preserve this playable fish's identity and appealing handmade illustration style even at maximum bite strength. Real integrated fish anatomy, no detached jaw, no beak, no mammal muzzle, no silly buck teeth. Teeth must emerge coherently from the jaw line, ivory natural bone with cool shaded roots, clean negative space between them; no floating or duplicated teeth and no extra eye.

Whole fish including every fin and tail, generous transparent padding on every side, character occupies about 85-90% of canvas width. Transparent alpha PNG; no background, no water or bubbles, no outside shadow or glow, no frame, no labels, no numbers, no extra fish, no comparison panels, no watermark. Match the reference landscape framing and canvas ideally 1675 x 939. High-resolution unanimated master artwork, clean readable bold shapes that survive reduction to 90px. Elegant limited values, subtle painterly texture, purposeful creature design rather than photorealism or vector clipart.

Give it a slightly longer straight mouth seam reaching toward the front edge beneath the eye, a modestly deeper firm blue-grey lower jaw, and about five or six clearly defined short ivory triangular fish teeth interlocking along the exposed mouth edge. Two front teeth are a little larger, but all remain compact and useful. A stronger lip ridge and subtle jaw muscle sculpting connect this mouth to the existing gill, without armour or decorative lines. Its jaw should read as distinctly more capable than the base fish's tiny three teeth, while staying nimble, modest and recognisably the first step. Do not make giant fangs or a massive long jaw at this first tier.

revisions.prompt:
Refine ONLY the teeth and immediate mouth slit of this exact fish artwork. Preserve its entire body, tail, all fins, smooth unarmoured head and forehead, round eye, blue-grey jaw, cheek and lip contours, framing, neutral swimming pose, and the hand-painted dark-ink EVO game style unchanged. This is the INTERMEDIATE BITE EVOLUTION, stronger than small triangular teeth, weaker than huge terminal fangs.

The current teeth resemble blunt little molars and a pig tusk. Replace that dentition completely with an anatomically convincing predatory FISH bite: a carefully designed row of SIX visibly pointed tapering ivory triangular-conical teeth, about three rooted in the upper jaw pointing downward and three rooted in the lower jaw pointing upward, with a clear dark gap between neighbouring teeth. Give every tooth a sharp tip rather than a square or rounded blunt end. The foremost upper and lower gripping teeth are each about 1.5 times the size of the others, sturdy, subtly swept back toward the tail, NO forward-curled pig tusk, NO exposed tooth roots. The visible teeth should interlock along the nearly closed dark mouth slit, not all emerge from the lower jaw. Upper fangs must visibly descend from the upper lip. Keep all teeth proportional to this intermediate fish, moderately large but NOT enormous saber teeth. Keep its strong deep lower jaw and relaxed pose. No grin, no tongue, no mammal teeth, no huge mouth opening, no armour or other changes. Entire fish on the same truly transparent alpha background, no outside shadows, no labels. Keep the native 1675 x 939 landscape canvas and generous empty margins. One fish only. Exceptional clean painterly finishing.
